The following RPC handler methods can transitively cause an outbound HTTP request to a user-configured webhook URL:

1. **`CreateMemo`** (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70`) — calls `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` (line 157)
2. **`UpdateMemo`** (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:401`) — calls `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` (line 513), which calls `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook`
3. **`DeleteMemo`** (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:518`) — calls `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` (line 562)
4. **`CreateMemoComment`** (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:20`) — calls `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` (line 119)
5. **`SetMemoRelations`** (`server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:16`) — calls `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` (line 48)
6. **`SetMemoAttachments`** (`server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:16`) — calls `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` (line 48)

All of these paths converge on the single function **`Post`** in `internal/webhook/webhook.go:119`. The dispatch methods (`DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook`, `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook`, `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook`, and `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`) each call `webhook.PostAsync()` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:183`), which enqueues the payload onto `asyncPostQueue`. Worker goroutines (started in `init()` at line 42) drain that queue and call `Post()` — the single convergence point that constructs and sends the actual outbound `http.POST` to the user-configured URL.

**Convergence function:** `Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:119`
